preconditions.description: n, m, and k are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= k for ai in alice_fish)
preconditions.description: All fish types caught by Alice are within the range [1, k].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= bi <= k for bi in bob_fish)
preconditions.description: All fish types caught by Bob are within the range [1, k].

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'YES' if any(sum(wi * count for wi, count in enumerate(alice_counts, start=1)) > sum(wi * count for wi, count in enumerate(bob_counts, start=1)) for wi in range(1, k+1)) else return_value == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if there exists a sequence of weights such that Alice's total weight is strictly greater than Bob's; otherwise, it is 'NO'.
